experiment: 8C actual single-block residual skip with periodic/adaptive refresh
prompt: What is 15 multiplied by 12? Explain briefly.
kv_cache_note: Built-in Hugging Face KV caching disabled for both baseline and caching runs; Exp8C residual cache remains enabled. The Dream sampler recomputes the full sequence per denoising step.
cache_mechanism: Refresh: original block.forward, cache FP32 residual H_out-H_in; reuse: skip original block.forward and return H_in(current) + cached residual
quality_limitations: Generated-token exact agreement and trajectory match are measured, but no semantic benchmark is run. Any mismatch does NOT prove bad quality; an exact match is a stronger correctness control. Adaptive input drift requires GPU->CPU synchronization and is included in latency.
systems_limitations: Only a single transformer block is cached at a time; edge/cloud split, boundary transfer, real network costs, and multi-block caching are NOT tested.
